title: How Delivery Request Works|#Assign Delivery|#Delivery |#Turns|#Delivery Info|#Create Request|#Mobile
description:
In this video we have covered the step by step process of Creating a New Delivery Request & How Delivery Request Works

0:00-Click On Dashboard
0:02-Request Shows On Dashboard
0:09-Click On Transaction
0:10-Click On Delivery Request List 
0:11-Delivery Request Opens
0:19-Driver Assign Alert Shows
0:31-Order List Opens
0:40-Update Order Status
0:46-Order Status Updated
0:53-Assign Delivery
0:58-Enter Delivery Details
1:11-Check order On Driver App
1:42-Order is Completed / Delivered
